items: Cat Couch Protector – This couch scratch protector from cats is designed to help reduce unwanted scratching while shielding fabric upholstery from everyday contact with pet claws and paws. These cat couch scratcher sheets are intended for use on fabric surfaces only and should not be applied to faux or genuine leather.

Extra Large Coverage – Each sofa protector for cats includes 6 XL sheets (12" × 17") and 6 Large sheets (10" × 17"), allowing you to cover large areas of upholstery with fewer pieces. The set also comes with 96 twist pins for optional reinforcement. Simply trim the couch cat scratch protector to fit for a neat, custom application.

Easy to Install – To apply these cat scratch furniture protectors, simply peel away the self-adhesive backing and press into place. The clear barrier acts as a physical cat deterrent, and twist pins are included for optional extra hold when needed.

Strong Cat Couch Protectors – Built thick enough to help prevent scratching while remaining flexible for a precise fit. Designed to wrap around corner couch areas, these couch corner protectors for cats provide targeted coverage where scratching happens most.

Customer Satisfaction – If you have any questions about this cat tape for furniture, the Panther Armor team is ready to help. We stand behind our product and will work with you to find the right solution as a furniture protector from cats scratching that actually works for your home.
